term.inflation.name: Inflation
term.inflation.life: A samosa that was ₹10 a few years ago is ₹15 today.
term.inflation.real: Inflation = the general rise in prices over time, usually given as a percent a year.
term.purchasingPower.name: Purchasing power
term.purchasingPower.simple: How much your money can buy.
term.purchasingPower.life: ₹100 buys fewer samosas today than it did five years ago.
term.purchasingPower.real: Purchasing power = the amount of goods a sum of money can buy. Inflation reduces it.
term.realReturn.name: Real return
term.realReturn.simple: What your money earned after prices rose.
term.realReturn.life: Your savings earn 6.5% and prices rise 6%. You are 0.5% ahead.
term.simpleInterest.name: Simple interest
term.simpleInterest.simple: Interest paid only on the money you put in.
term.simpleInterest.life: ₹1,000 at 10% earns ₹100 every year, never more.
term.compoundInterest.name: Compound interest
term.compoundInterest.life: A chai-stall owner puts the profit into a second stall. Next year both stalls earn.
term.compoundInterest.real: Compound interest = interest calculated on the principal plus the interest already earned.
term.ruleOf72.name: Rule of 72
term.ruleOf72.simple: A quick way to guess how long money takes to double.
term.ruleOf72.real: Rule of 72 = years to double ≈ 72 ÷ yearly rate in percent.
term.fixedDeposit.name: Fixed deposit (FD)
term.fixedDeposit.simple: One sum locked with a bank for a fixed time at a fixed rate.
term.fixedDeposit.life: ₹6,000 locked for 6 months comes back as ₹6,195.
term.fixedDeposit.real: Fixed deposit = a lump sum placed with a bank for a fixed tenure at a fixed interest rate.
term.prematureWithdrawal.name: Premature withdrawal
term.prematureWithdrawal.simple: Taking money out of a deposit before its time is up.
term.prematureWithdrawal.life: Breaking a 6-month FD after 3 months to pay a fee.
term.prematureWithdrawal.real: Premature withdrawal = closing a deposit before maturity. The bank pays a lower interest rate.
term.ruleOf70.name: Rule of 70
term.ruleOf70.simple: Divide 70 by the inflation rate to see how many years prices take to double.
term.smallSavingsScheme.name: Small-savings scheme
term.smallSavingsScheme.simple: A government-run savings scheme offered through post offices and banks.
term.taxOnInterest.name: Tax on interest
term.taxOnInterest.simple: Interest you earn counts as income and can be taxed.
